about.description: Helix is the premier decentralized spot and perpetual exchange on the Injective L1, built by Injective Labs (co-founded in 2018 by CEO Eric Chen and CTO Albert Chon, Stanford CS) and launched September 1, 2022. It offers commodity, equity, and equity-index perpetuals alongside crypto markets - all margined in USDT - and was an early venue to list pre-IPO/private-company perpetuals. Helix is known for one of the fastest growth curves in DEX history, attaining $1B cumulative volume in one month and over $7B+ across spot and perpetual markets.
about.registryInfo: Helix is built and operated by Injective Labs Inc., the R&D company behind the Injective L1 blockchain. Injective was co-founded in 2018 by Eric Chen (CEO; former cryptocurrency researcher) and Albert Chon (CTO; Stanford CS, former Amazon and OpenZeppelin engineer). Helix launched on Injective Mainnet on September 1, 2022 and reached $1B cumulative volume within its first month.

fees.revenueNotes: Helix (powered by Injective) standard perpetual fees: -0.5 bps maker rebate / 5 bps taker. Some markets have different rates - XRP and SEI perps charge -1 bp maker / 10 bps taker. VIP discounts available based on 28-day rolling volume and staked INJ. Fee recipient always receives 40% of the trading fee regardless of maker/taker designation. Source: https://docs.helixapp.com/trading/fees-and-rebates
